hypothesis: Graph-change and incumbent-gap directed revalidation of directly observed old action credits improves future-query accuracy over uniformly allocating the same paired-feedback quota after a background graph change.
novelty: PROVISIONAL; paired testing/graph pruning/cost accounting are existing tools. R1 tests a new graph-shift/feedback arrangement and heuristic, not a proved novel sequential test.
model: unchanged Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct; four fixed roles; two rounds; original scorer and aggregation

data.role: fresh-to-MAB2 development pilot, not final confirmation

acquisition.dirty: changed-background-edge receiver overlap with editable receiver; heuristic, not a validity certificate
acquisition.selection: descending score, exact ties by physical edge index; one edge pair frozen for all C12 questions
acquisition.updates: replace purchased edge cells with C paired action-gain mean; unpurchased cells retain g and source-graph provenance
acquisition.editor: argmax updated gain, edit only if max strictly>0 else stay; exact ties smaller physical edge index
acquisition.no_change: dirty=0, full candidate and no-graph ablation must be identical

uniform_reference: Exact expectation over all C(6,k) equally weighted frozen edge subsets, each replica sees only its own C purchases; no best-pair selection. Full cache remains evaluator-only.
cyclic_reference: Use sorted editable cyclic order starting at episode mod6; take k; no claim about adaptive temporal scheduling.

cost.primary_comparison: same conservative complete token-and-score upper caps plus same paired-feedback quota; actual costs separately reported
cost.definition: Input plus output tokens; base=8 workers*(8192+128)+(8192+256); flip=one worker plus aggregator. I12*(base+6flip)+C12*(base+2flip)+S24*base.
cost.noaudit: No C generation/scoring charged; actual savings retained, no free extra service offered by fixed-horizon design
cost.cost_normalization_ablation: not run: identical single-edge closure quote, structurally unidentifiable
cost.scoring_CPU: measured separately where possible, count limited; no money conversion or unknown cost imputation

statistics.primary: A->B, k2, candidate minus exact uniform expected accuracy, equal episode means over their24 S questions
secondary: difference of A->B and A->A contrasts
actual complete token and scoring costs
all episode outcomes and chosen edits
statistics.interval: 10000 episode bootstrap percentile95, seed69173, explicitly exploratory with8clusters
statistics.conditional_service_interval: question resampling within fixed episode policies may be descriptive only, not full training uncertainty
statistics.multiplicity: one primary; secondary intervals descriptive, not replacement gates

decision.validity_failure: quarantine and repair affected engineering artifacts; preserve attempts and costs; not candidate support
decision.candidate_progress_rule: If valid primary point gain>=0.01, candidate point gain versus source_only>=0, and budget makes an independently powered confirmation feasible, freeze one independent confirmation plan; this development signal is not proof. Otherwise record candidate failure/inconclusive and move to materially distinct candidate R2 without changing this protocol.
decision.project_on_candidate_failure: ACTIVE; outer-loop analysis then next candidate
decision.project_stop: only cycle2 autonomy contract enumerated project-level conditions

execution_order: Commit scientific protocol and code; select IDs before payload read
Real six-question qualification: full replay/cache/format/cost; no effect selection
Freeze source and worker plan; reserve full coverage before formal start
Collect hidden full menu; no labels on server
Open only I scores; freeze each purchase plan
Read purchased C feedback per replica; freeze all service actions
Open S scores to evaluator and compute all predeclared metrics
Independent arithmetic replay; candidate decision; update outer loop
scope_limits: Single fixed background change plus one edit per episode, not full online graph evolution
8 clusters do not ensure precise estimation of1-2pp effects
Four fixed roles of one3B model, no heterogeneous-pool claim
Restoring an absent template edge is measured; persistent multi-step paused-edge recovery is not established
